title: Kichwa language - Wikipedia
text: Kichwa is a Quechuan language that includes all Quechua varieties of Ecuador and Colombia, as well as extensions into Peru. It has an estimated half million speakers.

title: Quechuan languages - Wikipedia
text: The figure for Imbabura Highland Quechua in Ethnologue, for example, is 300,000, an estimate from 1977. The missionary organization FEDEPI, on the other hand, estimated one million Imbabura dialect speakers (published 2006).
